children: Sweden education provider's Q4 net sales rose 10.6% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst estimates
Adjusted EBITA for Q4 increased 16.2% yr/yr, driven by international operations
Company expanded in the Netherlands, UK, and Poland through acquisitions during the quarter
Company expects continued stable demand, with student enrolment seen up about 8% for next academic year
AcadeMedia sees good opportunities for further international growth through expansion and acquisitions
Company says demand for adult education programmes remains strong
INTERNATIONAL EXPANSION - Co said growth in international operations, especially in the Netherlands, UK, and Poland, was the main driver of Q4 earnings improvement
HIGHER ENROLLMENT - Co reported a 5.2% increase in average number of children and students, supporting revenue growth
ADULT EDUCATION GROWTH - Co said adult education segment delivered its strongest result to date, with adjusted EBITA up 14.6% yr/yr
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the miscellaneous educational service providers peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for AcadeMedia AB is SEK125.00, about 27.6% above its August 28 closing price of SEK98.00
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
